name: Vysto AI
description:
Vysto is a conversational website and content platform. This connector lets Claude read and update your Vysto workspace directly: draft and edit content ("nuggets"), manage branding (colors, fonts, logo, favicon), choose themes and section layouts, compose and publish modular pages with a full page builder, configure your Classic View navigation and page shell, upload images and video, and set your site live or to draft.

Every action runs against your own workspace only. Your connection resolves the workspace once at sign-in — MCP tools never accept a tenant id, so one site can never read or modify another. Content changes reuse Vysto's own validation, security scanning, and cache revalidation, so anything Claude publishes goes through the same safeguards as the dashboard.

Typical uses:
• "Write a services page and publish it."
• "Update our brand colors and upload a new logo."
• "Reorder the navigation and hide the pricing page."
• "Draft five FAQ entries and set them live."

Connect via Claude Settings → Connectors, then sign in and approve on the Vysto consent screen. Once approved, Claude can manage your site conversationally.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vysto AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vysto AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.vysto.ai/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vysto AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vysto AI lists 62 MCP tools, including apply_page_changes, archive_nugget, clear_working_tenant, create_nugget, create_page_layout, delete_page_layout, diff_page_layout, duplicate_page, get_branding, get_classic_view_settings, get_conversation_layout_catalog, and get_nugget.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vysto AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vysto AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Vysto AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vysto AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vysto AI is developed by Vysto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
